description: This Java source file defines the QueueStatsController class, which handles REST API endpoints for managing QueueStats entities in the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for retrieving queue statistics by tenant, by ID, and by list of IDs, with security annotations and API documentation.

classes.name: QueueStatsController
classes.description: Controller class for handling QueueStats REST API endpoints, extending BaseController, with security and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getTenantQueueStats
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of QueueStats for a tenant, with optional search and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getQueueStatsById
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch a specific QueueStats entity by its ID.

methods.name: getQueueStatsByIdsV1
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch multiple QueueStats entities by an array of IDs, marked as hidden.

methods.name: getQueueStatsByIds
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch multiple QueueStats entities by IDs, delegating to getQueueStatsByIdsV1.
